title: Report each user's landing page on every refresh

blocks.text: The marketing dashboard shows, for each user, the page they landed on: their first visit in the time range. One `VisitReport` object serves the dashboard while the application runs, and the dashboard asks it for a new report every few minutes, with that period's visits in the order they happened.

Write `firstPer(...)` and `landingVisits(...)` in `src/main/java/practice/VisitReport.java`. `firstPer(key)` is a reusable building block: a predicate that passes the first element it sees for each key and rejects the ones after it. `landingVisits` uses it to list each user's first visit, in the order the visits happened. About four lines in total.

cases.says: when every user visited once, every visit is listed, in order
a user who visited several times is listed once, with the earliest visit
a second report from the same object lists the users the first report already listed

origin.section: A Predicate That Remembers Answers Differently in Parallel and on Its Second Use

concepts: A predicate that keeps a seen-set remembers across uses, so built once and reused it rejects on its second use what it accepted on its first.
